card.title: The Approved Explanation
card.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

mechanism: A protects a driver and worried children through one repeatable account refined to include only necessary clarifying facts.
confusable: Unlike seeking approval for a new cover story, A maintains a shared simplified explanation as different audiences ask questions.
comparison: A parked-bus qualifier prevents a damaging inference; the gazebo scene keeps a birthday speech on safety and celebration.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
